title: IBC 2024 Table 1607.1 - Minimum live loads
captions: Source: CHAPTER_16_STRUCTURAL_DESIGN.pdf, pages 1-4. First Version: Aug 2023.
Numeric loads retain source units. A dash reproduces the source dash. Footnotes are on the Notes sheet.
